checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add Lee 2026 active-control and Vafa 2025 intervention-context reviews; cite as claim boundary and duration context

impact_assessment.benefits: Adds a direct active-control null result to the claim boundaries and grounds the no-dose-prescription copy with a 2025 synthesis.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Verify via efetch, update counts and references, add citations with failing-first tests, run suites and review UI.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two context records and two new UI citations; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: counts and references must move together
impact_assessment.why: The app's central honesty claim is that benefits shrink against active controls; a 2026 meta-analysis quantifies exactly that and was in the residual pool.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: extend citation-grounding to every UI source file so any hardcoded PMID must resolve to the corpus

impact_assessment.benefits: Turns a one-screen check into a project-wide invariant over all 75 in-app citations.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the same PMID regex and allowlist, add the assertion, run the suite and confirm all UI sources resolve.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: test-only change to one file using existing corpus; dependency: node fs/path only; concurrency: none; state: no app or evidence-count changes
impact_assessment.why: The grounding test only scanned EvidenceScreen; hardcoded citations in Home, Settings, Results, Menu and other panels could drift without detection.
